history.title: Revision history
history.pickTwo: Select exactly two revisions to compare ({{count}} selected).
history.emptyReason: Each save or accepted Change Proposal creates a revision.
history.noChange: The two revisions have the same content.
history.binaryChanged: Binary file — changed, no line comparison.
history.restoreDirty: Save or discard the changes of this file first.
history.restoreBinary: Binary files cannot be restored yet; upload the version you need again.
history.restored: Restored {{path}} to r{{from}} in revision r{{to}}. Earlier revisions are kept.
history.noProvenance: Direct edit; no Task, Agent Run or claim.
history.initProvenance: Manuscript start; no Task, Agent Run or claim.
